article.title: Banning Social Media for Kids Is a Bad Idea
article.summary: The risks are real. But banning children from the internet could create new problems without solving the ones that really matter.
article.title_zh: 禁止兒童使用社交媒體是個壞主意
article.summary_zh: 風險確實存在，但禁止兒童上網可能會造成新問題，而無法解決真正重要的問題。

article.title: SoftBank Weighs Deal for Robotics Startup Gravis
article.summary: SoftBank Group Corp. is considering an acquisition of Gravis Robotics AG, people familiar with the matter said, as the Japanese investor targets the artificial intelligence technologies underpinning robotics.
article.title_zh: SoftBank 考慮收購機器人新創公司 Gravis
article.summary_zh: 知情人士表示 SoftBank 正考慮收購 Gravis Robotics AG，該日本投資者鎖定支撐機器人的人工智慧技術。

article.title: Samsung chief explains why the Galaxy Z Fold 8 series is way cheaper in Korea
article.summary: TL;DR The launch prices of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra and Fold 8 in the US and Europe are far higher than the launch prices in Korea. Off to the side of the launch event, CEO TM Roh reportedly explained why the pricing is so much lower in the company’s home country. The executive described the Korean market as the “foundation for strengthening the Galaxy brand’s global competitiveness.” Yesterday, Samsung held its long-anticipated summer Galaxy Unpacked event, where it introduced the Galaxy Z Fold 8 series and Galaxy Z Flip 8 . While a price hike was expected, given the current state of the industry, it didn’t hurt any less to learn that we would be paying $100 more for the Fold 8 Ultra this year. article.title_zh: Samsung 首席執行官解釋為什麼 Galaxy Z Fold 8 系列在韓國便宜得多
article.summary_zh: Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra 和 Fold 8 在美國和歐洲的上市價格遠高於在韓國的上市價格。據報導，首席執行官 TM Roh 在發布會期間解釋了為什麼該公司在本國的定價要低得多。

article.title: Why Chip Engineers Should Care About AI-Created Behavioral Models
article.summary: You probably know this bottleneck too well: full transistor-level or physical simulations—whether analog circuit, electromagnetic, or thermal—can take weeks or even months. For complex designs, simulating every internal transistor in every block quickly becomes impractical. This is why creating accurate behavioral models is so important. A good behavioral model captures a block’s input-output behavior without carrying all the internal physics. It gives design teams a practical way to run more iterations, explore more tradeoffs, and save expensive golden simulations for the checkpoints that truly require full fidelity. article.title_zh: 為什麼晶片工程師應該關注 AI 生成的行為模型
article.summary_zh: 全電晶體級或物理模擬可能需要數週或數月，對複雜設計而言，模擬每個區塊的每個內部電晶體變得不切實際，因此創建準確的 AI 模型至關重要。

article.title: Google wants your face to be your backup password with new selfie video sign-in
article.summary: Credit: Joe Hindy / Android Authority TL;DR Google is introducing a new selfie video sign-in and account recovery method that lets users verify their identity with a short selfie video. The feature uses liveness checks, facial matching, encryption, and Google’s existing security systems to help prevent spoofing attempts. Users can delete their saved selfie video at any time and can choose whether or not Google can use their videos to improve its facial recognition and verification tech. Google is adding a new way for users to sign in and get back into their accounts when traditional recovery methods aren’t available. Called selfie video, the new feature allows users to record a short video of themselves and later use it to verify their identity when signing in to their Google account.
article.title_zh: Google 希望用您的臉作為備用密碼，推出新自拍影片登入
article.summary_zh: Google 推出新自拍影片登入和帳戶復原方法，使用者可用短自拍影片驗證身分，運用活體檢測、臉部辨識和加密等技術。

article.title: AI chip startup Etched defies skeptics, hits $10.3B valuation from big-name investors
article.summary: Etched, founded by three Harvard dropouts, has created new chips and memory components that speed up inference on any AI model -- no GPUs required, it says.
article.title_zh: AI 晶片新創公司 Etched 無懼質疑，獲得大牌投資者支持、估值達 103 億美元
article.summary_zh: 由三名哈佛輟學生創辦的 Etched 開發了新晶片和記憶體組件，能加速任何 AI 模型的推理運算，無需 GPU。

article.title: Runway launches AI model router as generative media gets crowded
article.summary: The Media Router is a tool that automatically selects the best image, video, or audio generation model for a request based on whether a developer prioritizes quality, speed or cost.
article.title_zh: Runway 推出 AI 模型路由器，應對生成媒體競爭加劇
article.summary_zh: Media Router 是一個工具，可根據開發人員對品質、速度或成本的優先順序，自動選擇最佳的圖像、影片或音頻生成模型。

article.title: Cursor, Ramp, and Meta are all building model routers — but two have major model ambitions themselves
article.summary: Cursor, the AI coding tool recently acquired by Elon Musk’s SpaceX in a $60 billion all-stock deal, has launched a model router designed to direct every coding request to whichever model handles it best, bypassing the need to pay frontier prices for work that doesn’t need it. Under the hood, the new Cursor Router uses a triage system à la a hospital emergency room: It looks at what a request actually needs — how hard it is, what it’s for, the surrounding code — and picks a model that is the best fit. A quick fix goes somewhere cheap, while a genuinely hard problem gets escalated to something closer to frontier-grade. Notably, developers and admins also have access to three distinct modes that nudge that balance in either direction, favoring speed and co
article.title_zh: Cursor、Ramp 和 Meta 都在構建模型路由器 — 但其中兩家擁有重大模型野心
article.summary_zh: 最近被 Elon Musk 的 SpaceX 以 600 億美元全股票收購的 AI 編程工具 Cursor 推出了模型路由器，可將編程請求導向最適合的模型，避免為不需要頂級模型的工作支付高昂費用。

article.title: Claude’s voice mode is getting a lot more useful with support for more models and tools
article.summary: TL;DR Claude’s voice mode can now use multiple models, including Opus and Sonnet. It can also use connected tools like Notion, Canva, and others to complete tasks in voice mode. The new update is rolling out in public beta on mobile, desktop, and the web. If you prefer talking to your AI chatbots, Anthropic has some great news for you. The company launched voice mode in Claude last year and started rolling out multilingual support last month. Now, Anthropic is giving the feature a major update that could make it better than the competition. Anthropic announced a couple of new features for Claude’s voice mode in an X post today. article.title_zh: Claude 語音模式支援更多模型和工具，變得更加實用
article.summary_zh: Claude 語音模式現支援 Opus 和 Sonnet 等多個模型，並可連接 Notion、Canva 等工具。

article.title: Charter bulks up on hotspot data, 4K streaming with 'Unlimited Plus Premium'
article.summary: Amid a move away from by-the-Gig plans, Charter has launched a new 'Unlimited Plus Premium' plan for Spectrum Mobile that features more hotspot data than its other unlimited plans.
article.title_zh: Charter 推出「Unlimited Plus Premium」方案，提升熱點數據和 4K 串流服務
article.summary_zh: 隨著業界逐漸放棄按 GB 計費方案，Charter 為 Spectrum Mobile 推出新的「Unlimited Plus Premium」方案，提供比其他無限方案更多的熱點數據。

article.title: OpenAI relaunches Apple Health-connected ChatGPT feature with expanded access

article.summary_zh: OpenAI 重新推出 ChatGPT 的 Health 功能，可連結 iPhone 上的 Apple Health，並提供擴大的使用範圍和改進的結果。

article.title: EU fines Google $1 billion for ‘preferential treatment’ in Search, Play Store
article.summary: Google is looking at two fines from the European Union, which claims the company violated the Digital Markets Act with both Search and the Google Play Store.
article.title_zh: 歐盟因 Search 和 Play Store 中的「優惠待遇」對 Google 罰款 10 億美元
article.summary_zh: 歐盟以 Google 違反《數位市場法》為由，對其 Search 和 Google Play Store 進行罰款。
